location: Happy Valley, Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong

main_turf.surface: Turf (Zoysia and Bermuda grass on high-drainage sand mesh base)
main_turf.stretch_length: 312m (A Course, 30.5m wide) | 338m (B / B+2 Course, 26.5m-24.5m wide) | 334m-335m (C / C+3 Course, narrowed to 22.5m-19.5m wide)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Iconic HKJC urban amphitheatre circuit hosting Wednesday night cards and select Sunday daytime fixtures (including the annual late-Oct/early-Nov Sunday card). Features a tight 1,450m cambered oval with a notable uphill climb along the back straight (900m to 600m) before sweeping downhill around the sharp Football Club home turn. Tactical gate speed ('E' and 'P' styles) and economical two-wide-with-cover or rail-hugging trips are paramount across all distances.
main_turf.post_bias: SEVERE INSIDE BARRIER BIAS (DRAWS 1-5): Over 1000m and 1200m, short runs to the first sharp turn give barriers 1-5 a decisive ground-saving edge. On C (22.5m wide) and C+3 (19.5m wide) rail settings, the narrowed track turns wide draws (9-12) into major liabilities unless the runner possesses elite first-200m gate speed to cross cleanly.

handicapping_angles.official_hkjc_rail_width_matrix_a_vs_c3: Check the day's official HKJC Course setting: A Course is 30.5m wide (312m straight) — wide enough for mid-pack stalkers ('P') and swoopers ('S') to circle cleanly. B/B+2 narrows to 26.5m-24.5m (338m worked-back straight). C (22.5m) and C+3 (19.5m — 11m narrower than A Course!) create an extreme bottleneck where inside rail leaders ('E') and box-seaters ('P') dominate (+3.5 pts rail-map upgrade on C/C+3).
handicapping_angles.backstretch_uphill_climb_and_football_cl: Happy Valley climbs uphill from the 900m to the 600m mark before banking downhill into the home straight. Penalize horses forced to loop 3-to-4 wide without cover up the backstretch hill; upgrade agile turn-foot horses ('P') that slingshot off the cambered final bend.
handicapping_angles.1000m_and_1200m_first_bend_barrier_lock: In 1000m dashes and 1200m dog-leg chute starts (~220m run to first turn), barriers 1-4 win at more than double the rate of barriers 9-12. Heavily downgrade wide draws (10-12) unless paired with an aggressive gate rider or dropping in class.
handicapping_angles.1650m_valley_mile_and_1800m_january_cup_: The 1650m Valley Mile starts directly in front of the winning post with a short run into the first turn (passing the post twice). Securing a top-five rail/one-off position before the first bend is critical. Hosts the G3 January Cup (1800m — Happy Valley's signature Group stakes race) and December LONGINES IJC.
handicapping_angles.daytime_sunday_vs_wednesday_night_surfac: On rare Sunday daytime Happy Valley meetings, warmer afternoon track temperatures and zero evening dew produce firmer, faster turf sectionals (~0.3s-0.5s quicker than humid night cards), further rewarding high-cruising-speed runners ('E' / 'P') and firmer-ground bloodlines.
handicapping_angles.hkjc_class_dropper_topweight_edge: In HKJC's strict rating bands (Class 1: 90+, Class 2: 80-100, Class 3: 60-80, Class 4: 40-60, Class 5: 0-40), horses dropping down a class band (e.g. rating 60->59 from Class 3 into Class 4, or Class 4 into Class 5) win at an elite strike rate even when carrying 132-135 lbs (+3.0 pts HKJC Class Dropper bonus).
handicapping_angles.sha_tin_to_happy_valley_transfer_switch: Sha Tin Class 3/4 runners switching to Happy Valley for the first or second time with natural early speed ('E'/'P') or proven tight-turn trials frequently spike in form (+2.5 pts), whereas long-striding one-paced Sha Tin grinders struggle on the tight bends.
handicapping_angles.valley_specialist_trainers_and_jockeys: Upgrade proven Happy Valley strike-rate trainers (Caspar Fownes 'King of the Valley', Mark Newnham, Danny Shum, Pierre Ng, Francis Lui, Ricky Yiu, David Hayes, John Size) and elite tight-track riders (Zac Purton, Hugh Bowman, Karis Teetan, Vincent Ho, Andrea Atzeni, Brenton Avdulla, Luke Ferraris) (+2.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard HKJC Happy Valley distances: 1000m, 1200m, 1650m, 1800m (G3 January Cup), 2200m.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 1 (Hong Kong Jockey Club Premier Amphitheatre HQ)
